title: Café Reel With Matching Captions
tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the supplied output frames

faults.what: The audio transcription reports unrequested speech, “نموذج مبسط.”, introducing unrelated spoken content into the café reel.
The final interior shot uses blurred pastry-photo strips above and below it, rather than a matching interior background, creating visibly inconsistent framing.

judge.summary: The 10.1-second vertical reel has large, readable captions in the sampled frames, but includes unrelated speech and does not demonstrate the required pastry caption.

must_haves.item: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
must_haves.why: The output is vertical and lasts 10.1 seconds; the sampled main images progress from storefront to latte to barista to interior, but the pastry segment falls between samples and cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
must_haves.why: Four captions are exact and paired with the expected subjects. “Something sweet” is not visible in the supplied samples. The original barista and interior attachments are not shown for direct comparison.

must_haves.item: Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
must_haves.why: All four visible captions fit comfortably inside the frame, but isolated frames cannot establish their display durations or the fifth caption's treatment.

must_haves.item: Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
must_haves.why: The visible captions are large, high-contrast white text over dark areas or translucent backing; the pastry caption cannot be assessed.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.
must_haves.why: The provided audio information reports speech and a peak level but does not establish whether music is present or mellow.
